note: Which kind of thing a word names, for closed classes of the language only: words of the calendar seen from now, seasons, kinds of day, days of the week, parts of the day. Words of grade or group (긴급, 단체 …) were listed on 2026-11-24 and taken out the same day: that class has no end and belongs to each field. A field's own words come from its packs, from sentences whose form decides (learn.note_kinds) and from answers to the reader's questions (learn.tell_kind). A name the field pack states outranks this file. One kind per word.

time.meaning: when something holds; fills the role a time fills

condition.meaning: a recurring circumstance of time under which a property is meant (season, kind of day, part of the day); fills the role a modifier fills
